hero.eyebrow: PivoxQuant · A mirror before you trade
hero.description: The data is clear: high-turnover trading shaves your returns every year — about 7 percentage points versus low turnover. PivoxQuant mirrors your own trading pattern back to you and makes you pause once, right before you hit buy or sell. No scoring, no recommendations. Observational data only, not a directive to act.
hero.disclaimer: Not investment advice. Informational research only. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

personas.heading:
A mirror that speaks
your investor language.
personas.description: Five onboarding questions record what you say about your own habits. That is only what you declared; the mirror watches what your last 30 days of trades say instead.
personas.alsoAvailable: Eight in all — Income, Quant, Speculator and Daytrader round out the set. The mirror explains the gap in the language of the one you picked.

cta.sub: Closed beta — everything is free. No payment details are collected. Start with a Google or Kakao account.

steps.heading: There are only three screens.
steps.deck: Nothing is written for you. Your own record is the only material, and all the tool does is show it back to you later.
steps.s1body: Seven questions before you hit buy. Why now, what would prove you wrong, whether you can afford to lose this. The time it takes to write the answers is the only friction.
steps.s1limit: It does not pick stocks for you.
steps.s2body: What you bought and what you almost bought sit in the same place. Holding period, turnover, concentration, averaging down, how you close winners and losers — five habits computed straight from your record.
steps.s3body: The investor you declared at onboarding, next to the investor your last 30 days of trades describe. Where those two diverge, across nine axes, is the whole of this tool.
steps.s3limit: It does not say which one is right.

faq.deck: What people ask most before starting the beta.
faq.heading: Before you begin.
faq.q1: Is this the same as investment advisory?
faq.a1: No. It falls outside licensed investment advisory under Article 6 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act. PivoxQuant is an informational research tool that reflects back the record and holdings you entered yourself. It does not pick securities, score them, or tell you to buy or sell. Every decision remains yours.
faq.q2: What do you do with my trade data — what does the mirror “observe”?
faq.a2: It places two things side by side: what you said about your own habits in the five onboarding questions, and the behaviour observed in your last 30 days of trades. Nine axes — average holding period, turnover, sector spread and so on — are computed from your own record; no new judgement is manufactured. Raw trade data is stored encrypted and is never used for advertising or sold onward. On account deletion it is fully erased within 30 days.
faq.q3: Does my investor type change over time?
faq.a3: The observed persona is recomputed from your last 30 days of trades. What you declared stays put until you answer the five questions again — the point of the mirror is to show where the two diverge, not to pick one for you.
faq.q4: What do I actually do here?
faq.a4: Three things. Pause before you buy and leave your reasoning in seven questions (Pre-Trade), record your holdings and trades (Portfolio), and weeks later look at the you those records describe (Mirror). It is not a service that sends you reports — your own record is the material.
faq.q5: Do you have access to my brokerage account?
faq.a5: No — and there is nothing to connect. Automatic brokerage linking is not offered; positions are entered by hand. No broker credentials are collected.
faq.a6: Everything is free during the closed beta. Paid plans are not active, and you will be told in advance if that changes.

whatIsService.a: PivoxQuant is an informational service providing generalized data, quant-model analysis, and AI-assisted observations for US and Korean equities. It is not investment advice and does not recommend specific securities or provide advice tailored to any individual. All information on the platform is for reference only. Investment decisions and their outcomes are entirely the responsibility of the user.

signalLabels.q: What do signal labels (POSITIVE / NEGATIVE / NEUTRAL) mean?
signalLabels.a: Signal labels are generalized summaries of observed data indicators — not directives to take any specific trading action (buy, sell, or hold). POSITIVE / NEGATIVE / NEUTRAL simply describe the direction in which the indicators were observed, presented neutrally without any recommendation.

dataSource.q: Where does the data come from?
dataSource.a: Price, financial, and disclosure data are sourced exclusively from officially licensed providers (FMP, Korea Investment & Securities API, SEC EDGAR, KRX/DART official public data, etc.). Unofficial scraping is not used. Data may be delayed or temporarily unavailable depending on source conditions.

pricing.a: Everything is free during the closed beta. Paid plans are not active, and you will be told in advance if that changes.

refund.q: How are billing and refunds handled?
refund.a: For billing or refund inquiries, please sign in and submit a request under the Billing & Refunds category in the 1:1 inquiry form. Processing timelines follow the Terms of Service and applicable law (including the E-commerce Act). Including your payment receipt with your inquiry speeds up resolution.

howToLogin.a: You can sign in with your Google or Kakao account. Separate email/password registration is not offered. If sign-in fails, try updating your browser to the latest version or disable private/incognito mode, then try again.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: You can initiate account deletion from the Settings screen. Upon deletion, personal data is handled in accordance with the Privacy Policy and applicable law (including PIPA). If you encounter any issues, please contact us via the 1:1 inquiry form.

pwa.q: Can I install PivoxQuant as an app? (PWA)
pwa.a: PivoxQuant is a Progressive Web App (PWA). On mobile or desktop browsers, use the 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install' option to install it like a native app. Once installed, it runs full-screen for a faster experience.

staleData.q: The data or screen looks outdated.
staleData.a: A data delay notice may appear at the top of the screen. Refreshing your browser will reload the latest data. If you have the PWA installed, try fully closing and reopening the app.

contact.a: After signing in, you can ask quick questions about billing, your account, or how to use the platform via 'Ask AI Support', or submit a direct inquiry through the 1:1 inquiry form. Your submitted inquiries and responses are available in 'My Inquiries'.

emailDelivery.allArtifacts: All artifacts arrive in your inbox as PDF + HTML.
